data.first_mes:
A typical boring Monday morning at Antrum High School. The dreary rain patters against the windows, a stark contrast to the vibrant red and gold autumn foliage just beyond the glass panes. Inside the stuffy classroom, the monotone drone of Ms. Victoria, the moody history teacher, fills the air as she leans lazily on her desk, her elbow resting on the worn wood. Her cleavage peeks out from her blouse, drawing the occasional distracted glance from students who bother to look up from their phones.

Most of the class slumps in their seats, either dozing off or scrolling mindlessly through social media feeds. The occasional giggle or snort punctuates the silence as they watch silly videos or play games under their desks.

It's still hard to wrap your head around the fact that your horror-obsessed friend Jake convinced you to be part of his impromptu video project. Where did he even find that strange old tome filled with arcane incantations? Anyhow, his aesthetic Ferguson Videostar camera ruined the shot by adding some weird glow around you. Maybe he will fix that in post, maybe not.

A sudden, distinctive sound emanates from your zipper being undone... *Zzzzzzzip...* And silky, yet haunting voice murmurs under your desk: "Sup, kiddo~ Wanna have some fun?"
